text:
Sam: Quick check — who's owning keystore evidence for SOC2 fieldwork next Wed? We need owners for: HSM staging smoke, audit log backfill, and CR approvals. Pinging early to avoid last-minute scramble.

Alex: I can own HSM staging smoke. Need a window for smoke tests with infra — prefer Tue morning.

Tara: I'll take auditlog backfill. ETA Fri EOD to finish sample backfill, but I need data-platform retention mapping to confirm sample windows.

Mike: CR approvals — 2 PRs blocking: #4321 (keystore migration) and #4344 (auditlog parser). Left comments on both. @Sam can we triage CRs by EOD?

Sam: Thanks. @Alex can you slot Tue 9-10? @Tara who is the data-platform contact so we can unblock backfill? I'll escalate CRs to review rotation.

Alex: Tue 09:00-10:00 works for me. I'll coordinate with @Jordan from ops. Also note we need test certs for the HSM; ops said they'll provision if we file a request.

Tara: Data-platform owner is @Maya — Maya, can you confirm retention window mapping for non-prod logs? Quick ack needed so I can pick sample ranges.

Maya: Acked. Non-prod retention is 30 days by default. I just uploaded the mapping doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/log-retention-nonprod — check section 2.

Mike: I'll try to get CR #4321 reviewed by EOD. For #4344 I need one more LGTM from security. @security-bot any auto-checks failing?

security-bot: Static scan passed. Failing: policy-check on auditlog schema (schema mismatch at line 12). See CI output: https://ci.redwood/12345 — attaching snippet.

Sam: Ok, plan:
- Alex runs HSM smoke Tue 09:00-10:00 (coordinate with Jordan).
- Tara finishes auditlog backfill by Fri EOD (depends on Maya mapping).
- Mike + Sam to clear CRs by EOD today; Sam will nudge reviewers.
- Jordan to attach key rotation runbook if fieldwork requires it.

```
Checklist:
- HSM smoke: owner Alex
- Auditlog backfill: owner Tara
- CR approvals: owner Mike / Sam
- Runbook attach: owner Jordan
```

Tara: One more question — does fieldwork need evidence for key rotation runbooks now, or can we attach post-fieldwork? If yes, ops will need the final runbook file before the evidence bundle cut.

Jordan: I can attach the runbook. @Tara send the final doc by Thu COB and I'll upload.

Sam: Great — I'll update the SOC2 checklist and add owners to the ticket. Quick status ping tomorrow 11:00am. :thumbsup:

Alex: Noted. I'll post the smoke run log to #eng-sre after the test and include timestamps.

Mike: Thanks everyone — will post CR updates here when done.

Sam: If any blockers pop up, drop them here or DM. Appreciate the fast responses.
